Upon receiving a report, the shop should conduct a prompt, impartial investigation, gathering relevant information while maintaining confidentiality as much as possible. The shop should communicate the steps it will take to address the concern and provide support to the affected staff member. The outcome of the investigation and any actions taken should be documented, and appropriate follow-up should be conducted to ensure the issue is resolved and does not recur. Staff should be made aware of the process and feel confident in using it without fear of retaliation.
